artworks.title: The Vision of Eliphaz
artworks.description: The image shows an ethereal figure surrounded by light appearing before several seated figures. The central figure is illuminated with an aura or halo, while the seated figures below look up in wonder. The border contains text, and the artwork features intricate line work and shading, creating an otherworldly atmosphere.

artworks.title: Job Rebuked by His Friends
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting four figures in a dramatic moment. The central scene shows one seated figure and others gathered around, expressing emotions through gestures and facial expressions. The background features rolling hills against a dark sky. Above and below the central image are lines of text in an ornate script. The text reflects on themes of suffering, faith, and judgment. The border of the drawing includes artistic flourishes and two small illustrative creatures—a bird with a branch and an owl. The style is reminiscent of William Blake.

artworks.title: Job's Evil Dreams
artworks.description: The image depicts a series of intertwined creatures and forms with exaggerated features and serpentine elements in fine detail. Swirling lines and patterns interlace within the figures, creating a sense of movement. The border of the image features handwritten text with reflective sayings or quotations. The composition and line work suggest themes of transformation and struggle.

artworks.title: The Wrath of Elihu
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group gathered under a starry sky. The image depicts a standing figure, pointing upward toward an open sky dotted with stars, surrounded by seated figures in various poses. The central focus is on the interaction between the standing figure and the seated group. The figures are detailed and accompanied by text with poetic and biblical references. The painting is in the style of William Blake, featuring his fusion of visual art and poetic text as well as his themes of spiritual and existential reflection. The surrounding border includes artistically rendered text panels.

artworks.title: The Lord Answering Job out of the Whirlwind
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The central image depicts an encounter between a figure and two kneeling figures. The style is intricate with detailed line work capturing motion and emotion. Above and below the central illustration are texts revealing the narrative. The top reads, "Who is this that darkeneth counsel by words without knowledge," while the bottom states, "Then the Lord answered Job out of the Whirlwind." The composition is framed in decorative borders, invoking a sense of divine interaction. The swirling lines convey a prophetic essence befitting the biblical story's drama.

artworks.title: The Creation
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a celestial scene with angels and symbolic imagery. In the central panel, a group of seven angels stand side by side with arms raised, surrounded by stars. Below them, an older figure appears commanding, while to his sides are figures kneeling. The surrounding border contains symbolic illustrations, including depictions of the sun and moon, and elements like waves and mountains. The illustration is accompanied by text that enhances the mystical and spiritual tone of the image.

artworks.title: Behemoth and Leviathan
artworks.description: This is a painting of fantastical creatures and celestial figures with scriptural text. The composition features a scene where mythical beings, including a majestic behemoth and a coiled serpent, are surrounded by angelic and human figures. The central image appears to be an illustration of biblical creatures with intricate detailing. Two ethereal angelic figures hover above, partially embracing or communicating with seated figures beneath them. The scene is rich in symbolism and detail, with ornamental borders embellished with flowing lines and accompanying scriptural text. This is in the style of William Blake, known for his illustrative style combining poetry, religious mythology, and fantastical elements.

artworks.title: The Fall of Satan
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a biblical scene with celestial beings surrounding a central figure on a throne. In the center, a figure falls upside down among swirling forms. The celestial figures, some with wings, show expressions of reverence or submission as they stand beside the central figure. Two figures at the bottom display different expressions. The image is bordered by flowing patterns and text related to judgment and divine oversight. The style is reminiscent of William Blake.

artworks.title: The Vision of God
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a spiritual or religious scene with accompanying text. The image depicts a robed figure standing with one arm extended, touching the head of a seated figure. This figure is accompanied by another seated figure. Behind them, a radiant halo is depicted. The composition is detailed with lines, surrounded by verses and lines of text.

artworks.title: Job's Sacrifice
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a central figure with uplifted arms, surrounded by kneeling figures and shining rays. The central figure is standing on a stone platform, looking up towards radiant light beams. The two kneeling figures on each side have their heads bowed. Above, rays of light suggest a divine presence. The border of the drawing includes angels or winged figures. Captions at the top and bottom suggest a biblical theme. The drawing features intricate line work conveying a strong emotional and spiritual message.

artworks.title: Job Accepting Charity
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with figures interacting under a tree. The central rectangular image shows robed figures beneath a tree, some seated and others standing. The scene is set against hills and an enclosure, with detailed tree branches above. Surrounding the central panel are decorative borders with floating figures and script. The artwork incorporates biblical references. The characters are depicted in a style similar to classical engravings with fine lines and shading. The composition combines illustrative storytelling with traditional artistic presentation, creating a serene and contemplative atmosphere.

artworks.title: Job and His Daughters
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure seated with two female figures surrounded by symbolic imagery and text. The image shows a central figure sitting with his hands outstretched, accompanied by two seated female figures draped in robes. The background contains circular frames with dynamic scenes and swirling figures. A border with acanthus foliage design and musical instruments at the corners surrounds the central illustration. Text features prominently at the top and bottom, with biblical references to the Daughters of Job and contemplative themes expressed in the annotations. The entire work is composed in meticulous detail, with linework that suggests an etching technique.

artworks.title: Job and His Wife Restored to Prosperity
artworks.description: This is an image depicting a group of figures playing musical instruments under a starry sky with a crescent moon. The figures wear flowing robes and have serene expressions. Animals lie calmly in the foreground. The scene is framed by an arch with decorative elements. Inscribed texts around the image relate religious messages and the biblical story of Job, emphasizing themes of faith and reward. The bottom text reads: "So the Lord blessed the latter end of Job more than the beginning." The drawing is detailed in the style resembling William Blake's spiritual artworks.

artworks.title: Dancing Children
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude, cherub-like figures dancing. The figures have intertwined arms and appear to be in a rhythmic motion. Their hair flows expressively, and their shaded, plump figures create a whimsical ambiance. The drawing is set against a simple, textured background that emphasizes the dynamic gathering in the foreground. The use of line work suggests an illustrative, almost sculptural quality to the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Enthroned, with Angels and Saints
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 19.4 x 14.7 cm (7 5/8 x 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene enclosed within an architectural frame. The central image is arch-shaped, depicting a seated central figure surrounded by a group of attentive figures, all adorned with halos. The composition features intricately carved columns, a geometrically patterned border, and small sculptural figures around the frame's top and bottom. At the top of the arch within the scene, a dove is depicted. The drawing combines ornate decorative elements with a sense of narrative focus.

artworks.title: Hercules Abducting Iole
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This print shows a battle scene with some people on horseback and some on the ground. In the center, the two horses charge at each other. On the right, a man in a crown sits on one of the horses, holding what looks like a long tree branch. Two people sit atop the horse on the left; the person in the front holds a long stick or club in one hand and a shield in the other, and their face is obscured by their upraised arm. Behind them, a nude person with long hair holds onto the person in front. This nude person also wears a crown. Below the hooves of the horses, two bodies are on the ground. On the left and right are two other people with weapons facing the center, one on the left with a bow and arrow and one on the right wielding a fish-shaped object. The scene is framed with foliage and cross-hatched lines. At the top is a horizontal scroll with text on it.

artworks.title: Foot Soldier Standing by a Tree
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slightly turned posture, looking off to the right. He is leaning against a tall staff with his right arm extended. He has detailed facial features, including a prominent nose and a determined expression. His hair appears styled or covered with a decorative hat with plumes. He wears a heavily detailed garment typical of the early 16th century, consisting of a jacket, shorts, and stockings. A sheath for a weapon is visible on his left side. The background features a natural setting with rocky terrains and sparse vegetation, with distant hills or mountains in the background. The bottom right corner of the image displays the date "1520" and an artist's monogram, "Isp."

artworks.title: The Penance of Saint John Chrysostom
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.3 x 7.7 cm (2 1/16 x 3 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: The image features two nude figures, an adult and a child, seen from behind. The adult is lying on their stomach on rocky terrain, with hair tied back in a braid. The child stands beside the adult, facing them, with short curly hair. They are in a natural setting with rocks and sparse vegetation. In the background, there are rolling hills, a distant castle-like structure, and a cloudy sky. The text "S. IOHANES. CRISOSTOMVS." is inscribed at the top of the image.

artworks.title: Ornament Panel with a Large Bearded Mask
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grotesque face surrounded by intricate foliage. The artwork features a central human-like face with exaggerated and somewhat distorted features, such as large ears and an open mouth. The face is surrounded by swirling, ornate leaves and floral elements. The black-and-white contrast and fine line work create a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: Ornament with Palmette and Two Dophin Heads
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornamental design. The image shows a symmetrical arrangement of intricate scrollwork with acanthus leaves, tendrils, and stylized floral elements. A shell-like structure is at the center, flanked by trumpet-shaped horns, from which floral motifs and vine-like scrolls extend outward. The design is richly detailed, with a strong use of line creating depth and texture, suggesting a decorative panel or architectural frieze. The composition is densely packed with ornamental details, creating a sense of movement and complexity.

artworks.title: Execution of a Man at a Market-Place of a Town
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 22.2 x 19.7 cm (8 3/4 x 7 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval city. The image shows a fortified city with high walls, towers, and a bustling scene inside. Within the walls, there are buildings with intricate roofs and detailed architecture. Various activities are occurring in the city, including groups of figures involved in different scenes. Flag-bearing soldiers and a congregation of individuals are part of the narrative. The drawing captures the essence of medieval life through its depiction of architecture and scene.

artworks.title: Various Men Kneeling on a Bridge in front of a Town
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: This is an image of a medieval city with an army preparing for battle. The scene shows a fortress with soldiers in armor mounted on horses carrying lances. The drawing is detailed and intricate, featuring elements like trees and city walls. The overall atmosphere conveys a sense of anticipation and grandeur.

artworks.title: Assembly of Four Kings, in the foreground Four Men
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: The image depicts eight people - four seated and four standing. The seated individuals are elaborately dressed in robes with detailed patterns and wear crowns. They sit on an elevated platform in ornate chairs or thrones. The standing figures wear layered garments and hats of varying styles. Some are depicted in a side profile, holding staffs or batons. The background includes architectural elements, possibly columns or a wall, and the ground is tiled with geometric patterns. The image is detailed with careful line work to depict textures and patterns.

artworks.title: A Message Concerning the White King's Marriage
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Paul J. Sachs
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a full-body view. The central figure stands facing the man on the left, who appears to be speaking or gesturing with his hand. The man on the left has an older appearance with a prominent nose and chin, and wears robes that drape down to his feet. The central figure also faces left, wearing an elaborate fur-lined coat with intricate patterns, and has long, wavy hair. On the right, a third figure stands facing forward, dressed in detailed armor, complete with ornamental elements, and sporting a plumed helmet. Each person is distinct in dress. The setting appears to be an ornate building interior with tall, decorated columns and arched features framing windows through which a partly cloudy sky is visible. The floor is patterned with large, alternating light and dark tiles.
